// Check that the register model returns its blocks, registers and
// memories in creation order, independent of where the objects are
// located in memory. The objects are placed in reverse address order,
// so that address order and creation order differ.

#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

#include <new>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

using namespace uvm;

#define N 4

class reg_t : public uvm_reg
{
 public:
  uvm_reg_field* f;

  reg_t( const std::string& name = "reg_t" ) : uvm_reg(name, 32, UVM_NO_COVERAGE)
  {}

  virtual void build()
  {
    f = uvm_reg_field::type_id::create("f");
    f->configure(this, 32, 0, "RW", 0, 0x0, true, false, true);
  }
};

class sub_blk_t : public uvm_reg_block
{
 public:
  sub_blk_t( const std::string& name = "sub_blk_t") : uvm_reg_block(name)
  {}

  virtual void build()
  {
    default_map = create_map("default_map", 0, 4, UVM_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
  }
};

// storage, filled from the highest address downwards
alignas(reg_t)     static char reg_buf[N][sizeof(reg_t)];
alignas(uvm_mem)   static char mem_buf[N][sizeof(uvm_mem)];
alignas(sub_blk_t) static char blk_buf[N][sizeof(sub_blk_t)];

class top_blk_t : public uvm_reg_block
{
 public:
  reg_t* regs[N];
  uvm_mem* mems[N];
  sub_blk_t* blks[N];

  top_blk_t( const std::string& name = "top") : uvm_reg_block(name)
  {}

  virtual void build()
  {
    default_map = create_map("default_map", 0, 4, UVM_LITTLE_ENDIAN);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    {
      std::ostringstream name;
      name << "r" << i;
      regs[i] = new (reg_buf[N-1-i]) reg_t(name.str());
      regs[i]->configure(this, nullptr, "");
      regs[i]->build();
      default_map->add_reg(regs[i], 4 * i, "RW");
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    {
      std::ostringstream name;
      name << "m" << i;
      mems[i] = new (mem_buf[N-1-i]) uvm_mem(name.str(), 16, 32, "RW", UVM_NO_COVERAGE);
      mems[i]->configure(this, "");
      default_map->add_mem(mems[i], 0x1000 * (i + 1), "RW");
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    {
      std::ostringstream name;
      name << "b" << i;
      blks[i] = new (blk_buf[N-1-i]) sub_blk_t(name.str());
      blks[i]->configure(this, "");
      blks[i]->build();
      default_map->add_submap(blks[i]->default_map, 0x10000 * (i + 1));
    }

    lock_model();
  }
};

template <typename T>
void check_order( const std::string& what, const std::vector<T*>& objs,
                  const std::string& prefix )
{
  std::cout << what << ":";
  for (unsigned int i = 0; i < objs.size(); i++)
    std::cout << " " << objs[i]->get_name();
  std::cout << std::endl;

  if (objs.size() != N)
  {
    UVM_ERROR("Test", what + ": unexpected number of objects");
    return;
  }

  for (unsigned int i = 0; i < objs.size(); i++)
  {
    std::ostringstream name;
    name << prefix << i;
    if (objs[i]->get_name() != name.str())
      UVM_ERROR("Test", what + ": expected '" + name.str() +
                "' but got '" + objs[i]->get_name() + "'");
  }
}

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  uvm_coreservice_t* cs = uvm_coreservice_t::get();
  uvm_report_server* svr = cs->get_report_server();

  top_blk_t* top = new top_blk_t();
  top->build();

  std::vector<uvm_reg*> regs;
  top->get_registers(regs, UVM_NO_HIER);
  check_order("block registers", regs, "r");

  std::vector<uvm_mem*> mems;
  top->get_memories(mems, UVM_NO_HIER);
  check_order("block memories", mems, "m");

  std::vector<uvm_reg_block*> blks;
  top->get_blocks(blks, UVM_NO_HIER);
  check_order("block sub-blocks", blks, "b");

  regs.clear();
  top->default_map->get_registers(regs, UVM_NO_HIER);
  check_order("map registers", regs, "r");

  mems.clear();
  top->default_map->get_memories(mems, UVM_NO_HIER);
  check_order("map memories", mems, "m");

  std::vector<uvm_reg_map*> maps;
  top->default_map->get_submaps(maps, UVM_NO_HIER);
  std::cout << "map submaps:";
  for (unsigned int i = 0; i < maps.size(); i++)
  {
    std::cout << " " << maps[i]->get_full_name();
    if (maps[i] != top->blks[i]->default_map)
      UVM_ERROR("Test", "map submaps: unexpected order");
  }
  std::cout << std::endl;

  svr->report_summarize();

  if (svr->get_severity_count(UVM_FATAL) +
      svr->get_severity_count(UVM_ERROR) == 0)
    std::cout << "** UVM TEST PASSED **" << std::endl;
  else
    std::cout <<"!! UVM TEST FAILED !!" << std::endl;

  return 0;
}
